paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer interaction into actionable insight mirrors my passion for turning raw data into clear, business‑driving narratives. I thrive on building systems that surface hidden patterns from unstructured text, just as you do for brands like Uber and Amazon.

I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows using Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, creating end‑to‑end pipelines that retrieve and generate context‑aware responses from large knowledge bases.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R with tidymodels, employing a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and MCC evaluation to maximise predictive accuracy.
